items.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: INTERVIEWER: My name is Dr. Michael Woods.

ctx.x: Bassist John Heard grew up in Pittsburgh and is a sought after musician both in recording sessions and at jazz festivals. His career includes stints with the Count Basie Orchestra and many small combos in the swing and classic jazz world. He currently performs with Lionel Hampton’s Golden Men of Jazz and his own LA-based group The Elders.
John was interviewed by Michael Woods and Monk Rowe on March 4, 1995 in Scottsdale Arizona. Mary Kopcza was also present for the interview.

Greetings. We are here once again filming interviews with great American jazz artists for Hamilton College to create an archive. And we are very very flattered to have John Heard with us. My name is Dr. Michael Woods. My associate is Monk Rowe.
